name: Fish and Feed a Brainrot! 🐟
desc:
🎣 Fish and Feed a Brainrot!  

1. Hatch Brainrots from eggs 🥚  
2. Cast your rod to catch fish 🐟  
3. Feed your fish to them and watch them grow! ⭐  

💰 Earn cash, upgrade your stuff, and discover rare evolutions! 
⚡ Your Fishermen keep fishing even when you’re offline!

creator.name: First we Fish then we Feed
